prompt: Create ONE production-ready UI icon atlas image for a chibi Touhou-inspired shrine danmaku roguelite. A precise 4 by 4 grid of 16 separate pictorial icons on truly transparent background. Each square cell is identical size; icon centered with generous 18 percent padding, no lines between cells, no captions, no letters, no numbers. Hand-painted gouache with clean dark indigo contours, cream paper highlights, restrained vermilion and ice cyan, antique gold accents, readable at 64 px. Cohesive silhouette, not photoreal, not glowing sci-fi, no frames, no backgrounds, no visible checkerboard. EXACT grid order left to right top to bottom: ROW1: a cyan magical icicle; a silver crescent throwing blade; an orange flaming fireball; a violet four-point laser star. ROW2: a vermilion pillar wrapped with swirling fire; a pale blue ice mortar sphere with a tiny trailing cloud; a cream paper ofuda talisman with vermilion ink seal and flowing indigo ribbons; a crossed vermilion arrowhead and paper charm representing attack power. ROW3: a red camellia heart representing health; a pale blue hexagonal shield representing armor; a feather with two curved wind strokes representing move speed; a small amber crystal with concentric suction arcs representing pickup radius. ROW4: a green budding leaf with two tiny stars representing regeneration; a small gold hourglass representing cooldown; a cyan faceted spirit crystal representing experience; an amber coin tied with red shrine cord representing money. Image intended as a single RGBA atlas texture, each cell independent and unconnected; all 16 motifs must stay inside their own cell.
models: Five original procedural OBJ models; see Meshes.json and the project art documentation.
